decisions.decision: At Barbarian class level 20, the shared Rage resource has Unlimited uses; Primal Rage retains its once-per-encounter limit. Before level 20, uses are 2 at class level 1, 3 at 3, 4 at 6, 5 at 12, 6 at 17. One use returns on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.
decisions.decisionBasis: Dorks & Dice Owner approval, 2026-10-19, following Band 1 base-class comparison. No general player-class edition precedence.

decisions.decision: At Barbarian class level 11, when raging and reduced to 0 HP without being killed outright, a successful DC 10 Constitution save causes current HP to be twice Barbarian class level instead. Each subsequent use increases DC by 5; a Short or Long Rest resets DC to 10.
decisions.decisionBasis: Dorks & Dice Owner approval, 2026-10-19, resolving SRD 5.1 (1 HP) versus SRD 5.2.1 (twice Barbarian class level).

evidence.name: Relentless Rage
evidence.detail: 2 x Barbarian class level after success
